visualCharacteristics.layout: Flex wrap, centred, max-width 1170px; 330px cards (3 per row at 1440, 1 per row on mobile), equal height per row.
visualCharacteristics.card: 2px solid #f0f3f5 border, padding 40px, margin 10px (2px 2px 0 0 at 768-991px); whole-card hover background #f0f3f5.
visualCharacteristics.icon: Font Awesome solid SVG from /icons (fa-<name>.svg) painted #007acb through a CSS mask, 48px tall, width from the SVG viewBox (60/60/54/48/48/48).
visualCharacteristics.title: h4 15px/1.3 weight 500, margin 19.95px 0; link #007acb, underline on hover.
visualCharacteristics.description: p 16px/1.65 margin 16px 0; whole paragraph is a #007acb link to the same page as the title.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Service / feature link cards with a coloured icon, title and description.

contentPattern.structure: One card per row. Icon token (:fa-user-plus:) in its own paragraph, arriving as text or span.icon; h4 title link; description link (kept as a plain link, never a button).

reuseGuidance: Use for icon + title + description link cards on mybeckman.in. Icons live in /icons as fa-<name>.svg (Font Awesome Free 5.15.4 solid); add new ones there.
